title: Schools continue integrating music therapy into autism support programs
summary: More schools are partnering with music therapists to bring rhythm-based and interactive singing activities into daily programming for autistic students, alongside continued research into music's role in supporting social skills development. Specialized educator training programs, including autism-focused music education concentrations at conservatories, are also expanding to build a pipeline of qualified practitioners.
